_comment: Realty REST egg for Pterodactyl. Exported/imported via Admin > Nests > Import Egg.
name: Realty REST
author: 42793301+md5sha256@users.noreply.github.com
description: Standalone, read-only HTTP API over a Realty MariaDB database. Configured entirely by environment variables -- no config file is templated by the egg. The HTTP server binds the port of the server's primary allocation.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Downloads a prebuilt realty-rest jar from a GitHub Release and stages it as
# realty-rest-all.jar, matching this egg's startup command.
#
# Nothing is compiled here. The jar is published by the "Release realty-rest"
# workflow when a release is published, and downloaded anonymously -- GitHub
# Release assets need no token, unlike the Packages Maven registry.
#
# REALTY_REST_VERSION pins the version. It is deliberately not "latest":
# realty-rest refuses to start unless the database schema is exactly the version
# it was built against, so it must be upgraded in lockstep with the Realty
# plugin. A reinstall must therefore produce the same jar it produced before,
# not whatever has been released since.
set -euo pipefail

REPO="${REALTY_REST_REPO:-MCCitiesNetwork/realty}"
VERSION="${REALTY_REST_VERSION:-}"

if [ -z "${VERSION}" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: REALTY_REST_VERSION is not set. Set it to a released version, e.g. 1.5.1."
    exit 1
fi

# Release tags carry no v prefix (1.5.1, not v1.5.1), matching this project's
# existing tags. A leading v is still stripped from the operator's input, so
# typing "v1.5.1" resolves to the same release rather than 404ing.
VERSION="${VERSION#v}"
JAR="realty-rest-${VERSION}-all.jar"
URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/${VERSION}/${JAR}"

apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

echo "Downloading ${JAR} from ${URL}"
if ! curl --fail --location --show-error --silent -o realty-rest-all.jar.part "${URL}"; then
    echo "ERROR: could not download ${URL}"
    echo "       Check that version ${VERSION} has a published release with that asset:"
    echo "       https://github.com/${REPO}/releases"
    rm -f realty-rest-all.jar.part
    exit 1
fi

# curl --fail already rejects an HTTP error, but a truncated transfer can still
# leave a short file behind. Staging through .part means a failed install never
# leaves a half-written jar that the startup command would try to run.
if [ ! -s realty-rest-all.jar.part ]; then
    echo "ERROR: downloaded file is empty."
    rm -f realty-rest-all.jar.part
    exit 1
fi

mv realty-rest-all.jar.part realty-rest-all.jar

echo "Install complete: /mnt/server/realty-rest-all.jar (realty-rest ${VERSION})"

variables.name: Realty REST Version
variables.description: The released version to install, e.g. 1.5.1 (release tags carry no v prefix, but typing one is accepted). Must be a version with a published release asset. realty-rest requires the database schema to be exactly the version it was built against, so upgrade this in lockstep with the Realty plugin -- reinstalling always fetches this exact version, never the latest.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: MariaDB JDBC URL, without the jdbc: prefix (the app prepends it). Example: mariadb://db-host:3306/realty

variables.name: Database Username
variables.description: MariaDB user the service authenticates as. Read-only access is sufficient; realty-rest never writes.

variables.name: Bind Host
variables.description: Address the HTTP server binds to inside the container. Leave as 0.0.0.0 unless you know you need otherwise.

variables.name: Max Page Size
variables.description: Upper bound accepted for the pageSize query parameter on paginated endpoints. Hard-capped at 100 by the service: a larger value here is clamped, not honoured.

variables.name: CORS Allowed Origins
variables.description: Comma-separated list of origins permitted to call this API from a browser, e.g. https://realty.example,http://localhost:5173. Leave blank to disable CORS entirely, which is the default -- a browser front end on another origin cannot reach this service until its origin is listed here.

variables.name: Query Module URL
variables.description: Base URL of the query-service module used to enrich responses (e.g. world dimension, player display name). Leave blank to disable enrichment -- those fields are returned as null.

variables.name: Query Module Secret
variables.description: Shared secret sent to the query-service module on every call. Only used when Query Module URL is set.

variables.name: Query Module Timeout (ms)
variables.description: Per-call timeout before a module-sourced field degrades to null.
